title: Daily Devotional #42
paragraphs: As I meditate on Mark 14, I am reminded of your great love and sacrifice for us. This chapter is filled with events that lead up to your crucifixion, and it is difficult to read without feeling a sense of sadness and pain.

The first event that stands out to me is when the woman poured expensive perfume on your head. Some of the people there criticized her, saying that the perfume could have been sold and the money given to the poor. However, you defended her and said that what she had done was beautiful and that it would be remembered forever.

Lord, this shows me that you value acts of love and devotion, even when they seem extravagant or unnecessary to others. Help me to be more like this woman, willing to pour out my love for you without hesitation or concern for what others may think.

The next event in this chapter that moves me is when you gather with your disciples for the Last Supper. You tell them that one of them will betray you, and they all express their shock and disbelief. Peter even declares that he will never deny you, but you tell him that before the rooster crows twice, he will deny you three times.

This exchange is a reminder that even those who are closest to you can fall away or betray you. It is a sobering thought, but it also reminds me of your forgiveness and grace. No matter how many times we deny you or fall short of your expectations, you are always ready to welcome us back with open arms.

Finally, I am struck by your prayer in the Garden of Gethsemane. You ask your disciples to stay with you and keep watch, but they fall asleep. You are in such agony that you sweat drops of blood, and you cry out to God, asking if there is any other way for the cup of suffering to be taken from you.

Yet, you ultimately submit to God's will, saying, "not what I will, but what you will." This is a powerful example of surrender and trust, even in the face of unimaginable pain and suffering. Lord, help me to have this same level of faith and trust in you, no matter what challenges I may face.

In conclusion, Mark 14 is a powerful reminder of your love, sacrifice, and faithfulness. Help me to remember these lessons and apply them to my own life, so that I may grow closer to you and become a better disciple of your teachings. Amen.
